question: Find the headphone models that are not in stock in any store.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "headphones" AS SELECT "headphone_id" AS "headphone_id", "model" AS "model", "class" AS "class", "driver_matched_db" AS "driver_matched_db", "price" AS "price", "construction_earpads" AS "construction_earpads" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "inventory" AS SELECT "store_id" AS "store_id", "headphone_id" AS "headphone_id", "quantity" AS "quantity" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "stores" AS SELECT "store_id" AS "store_id", "name" AS "name", "neighborhood" AS "neighborhood", "parking" AS "parking", "date_opened" AS "date_opened" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH inv_clean AS (
    SELECT 
        headphone_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN quantity IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN regexp_matches(quantity, '^-?\d+$') THEN CAST(quantity AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS qty
    FROM inventory
), inv_agg AS (
    SELECT headphone_id, COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM inv_clean
    GROUP BY headphone_id
)
SELECT h.headphone_id, h.model
FROM headphones h
LEFT JOIN inv_agg ia ON h.headphone_id = ia.headphone_id
WHERE COALESCE(ia.total_qty, 0) = 0
ORDER BY h.model
S:
# Compute headphone models that are not in stock in any store (total quantity across all stores equals 0 or null)
# quantity is a string; cast to integer safely, treating non-numeric/null as 0

# Create result table with models that have zero total quantity across all inventory rows
query = '''
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH inv_clean AS (
    SELECT 
        headphone_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN quantity IS NULL THEN 0
            WHEN regexp_matches(quantity, '^-?\\d+$') THEN CAST(quantity AS INTEGER)
            ELSE 0
        END AS qty
    FROM inventory
), inv_agg AS (
    SELECT headphone_id, COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM inv_clean
    GROUP BY headphone_id
)
SELECT h.headphone_id, h.model
FROM headphones h
LEFT JOIN inv_agg ia ON h.headphone_id = ia.headphone_id
WHERE COALESCE(ia.total_qty, 0) = 0
ORDER BY h.model
'''
